title: Towards Trustworthy Physical AI: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
abstract: arXiv:2607.22877v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physical AI refers to AI systems that understand, reason about, and act in accordance with the physical world and its underlying laws, dynamics, and constraints. Unlike conventional AI systems, physical AI interacts continuously with uncertain physical environments, and its actions produce consequences that are physically irreversible. As existing trustworthy AI frameworks have been developed primarily for digital AI systems, they do not fully capture the distinctive challenges of physical AI, such as physical safety, cyber-physical security, and physical manufacturing process. To address this gap, we present a survey of trustworthy physical AI principles. First, we characterize the core capabilities and challenges of physical AI. Second, we examine the role of physics in AI. Third, we trace the end-to-end physical AI life cycle across five core stages and introduce Trustworthy Physical AI Operationalization (T-PAIO). translated_title: 迈向可信物理人工智能：跨生命周期的从理论到实践
translated_abstract: 物理人工智能是指能够理解、推理并遵循物理世界及其底层规律、动力学和约束来行动的AI系统。与传统的AI系统不同，物理AI需要持续与不确定的物理环境进行交互，其行为产生的后果在物理上是不可逆的。由于现有的可信AI框架主要是为数字AI系统开发的，它们无法完全涵盖物理AI所面临的独特挑战，例如物理安全、信息物理安全和物理制造过程。为了弥补这一空白，我们对可信物理AI的原则进行了综述。首先，我们刻画了物理AI的核心能力和挑战。其次，我们研究了物理学在AI中的作用。第三，我们梳理了物理AI横跨五个核心阶段的端到端生命周期，并提出了可信物理AI运营化。第四，我们发展……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文系统综述了可信物理AI的核心原则，提出了覆盖五个核心阶段的端到端物理AI生命周期框架T-PAIO，以应对物理AI在物理安全、信息物理安全和物理制造过程等方面的独特挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a survey of trustworthy physical AI principles and introduces T-PAIO, an end-to-end operationalization framework across five life cycle stages, to address the unique challenges of physical AI such as physical safety, cyber-physical security, and physical manufacturing processes.
